interpretation.plain_speak: The extra load does not need to arrive dynamically. Putting the same extra write in before the action window causes exactly the same breakdown as the mid-window burst, while placing it in the final round does not. Under higher effective load, total reachable action count is no longer enough; deployment timing also matters.
interpretation.next_stage: under static extra pressure, group outcomes by reachable budget plus onset and throughput to identify the minimal temporal resource coordinate that restores collapse
